recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining stale example guidance without changing the approved authoritative definitions. Any broader future clarification of Task.basedOn/Task.focus should be handled by a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-29636 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested clarification of Task.basedOn and Task.focus, added usage guidance distinguishing authorization from reason, changed Task.focus to the request being fulfilled or resource being manipulated, and replaced the old Task.reason guidance with guidance that reason is typically absent for please-fulfill Tasks because the reason is conveyed on the request in Task.focus.
initial_application: Commit 0a661c71ffaacaccce7844d52d494467bbb2dc5c applied the main FHIR-29636 changes to the Request pattern spreadsheet and Task StructureDefinition. Commit 98e442708fa9b592c6ebff8e8f29c2d8f8a76686 later corrected stale names and examples in the same Task.basedOn definition for FHIR-31427. A later Task.reason refactor, fbb011b3a96, converted reasonCode/reasonReference to Task.reason but preserved the superseded Task.reason guidance as literal example data.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini, and task-example1, task-example5, and task-example6 are active Task examples. Current Task StructureDefinition and request mapping exception source already carry the approved FHIR-29636 definitions/comments. The linked Zulip thread captures the reporter's concern, and FHIR Workflow minutes record the Persuasive with Modification vote. Later OO minutes show ongoing workflow/COW discussion about Task.basedOn and Task.focus but no final core reversal.
reconciliation: Removed the obsolete Task.reason blocks from source/task/task-example1.xml, source/task/task-example5.xml, and source/task/task-example6.xml. Each is a fulfill Task with Task.focus pointing at ServiceRequest/lipid, so publishing the old reason guidance as example data contradicted the accepted Task.reason usage note.
